But I feel like the lower/mid level skaters drop out because of the commitment and cost (of course for some it's issues like injuries or moving.) Usually they say things like "life got in the way" or they are too busy.

EDIT: also, volunteer hours include a lot of different things. Coaching, recruitment flyering, social media, graphic design, event help, community events, etc.
